name: this is fine
description: A dog sips coffee in a room engulfed in flames and says this is fine: forced calm and denial while everything falls apart.
voice: Everything is going wrong around me and I am going to keep smiling and act like it's all under control.

name: drake
description: A man turns away from one option with distaste, then points approvingly at another: rejecting one thing and preferring the other.
voice: I am rejecting this option with obvious distaste, then turning to approve of this other one instead, because it's clearly the better choice.

name: distracted boyfriend
description: A man walking with his partner turns to ogle someone else while she glares: being tempted away from what you already have.
voice: I already have something good right beside me, but I cannot stop myself from turning to look at someone else instead.

name: expanding brain
description: Brains grow brighter panel by panel as ideas get more absurd: mock enlightenment, ranking ideas from sensible to ridiculous.
voice: Each new idea I have feels more enlightened than the last, though really I'm only getting more absurd while convinced I'm getting wiser.

name: math lady
description: A woman stares into space while equations float around her: utter confusion trying to work something out.
voice: I am trying to piece this together in my head, and the more I think about it the further the answer slips away from me.

name: fry squint
description: A cartoon man narrows his eyes: not sure if something is what it seems, suspicious and doubtful.
voice: Something about this seems off to me, and I cannot tell if I should trust what I am looking at or not.

name: surprised pikachu
description: A cartoon creature with its mouth wide open: fake shock at an entirely predictable consequence of one's own actions.
voice: I brought this entirely on myself, and now I am acting utterly stunned that it turned out exactly the way I should have known it would.

name: michael jackson popcorn
description: A man eagerly eats popcorn in a cinema: watching drama unfold with delight, just here for the show.
voice: None of this concerns me directly, and I am thoroughly enjoying every bit of the drama as it unfolds in front of me.

name: skeleton waiting
description: A skeleton sits on a bench in the woods: waiting forever for something that never comes.
voice: I have been waiting here for so long that time itself seems to have stopped, and I am starting to think this will never come.

name: woman yelling at cat
description: A woman screams and points while a confused cat sits at a dinner table: a heated accusation met with indifferent bafflement.
voice: I am furious and pointing the blame squarely at you, while you just sit there completely unmoved by anything I am saying.

name: success kid
description: A toddler on a beach clenches a fist of sand with a determined grin: a small victory, things going your way.
voice: I did the small thing I set out to do, and right now it feels like absolutely everything is finally going my way.

name: disaster girl
description: A little girl smirks at the camera while a house burns behind her: quiet satisfaction at chaos you may have caused.
voice: Something behind me is falling apart, quite possibly because of me, and I cannot help feeling pleased about it.

name: hide the pain harold
description: An older man smiles for the camera but his eyes show suffering: masking pain behind a polite smile.
voice: I am in real pain right now, but I am going to keep this smile fixed in place so no one asks what is wrong.

name: roll safe
description: A man taps his temple with a knowing look: smug faulty logic, a clever-seeming idea that is actually dumb.
voice: I have found a loophole that feels brilliant to me, a clever way around the rule that technically works even though it solves nothing.

name: kermit sipping tea
description: A frog sips tea looking away: passive-aggressive judgement, but that's none of my business.
voice: I have an opinion about what you are doing, and I am not going to say it out loud, but I am absolutely judging you.

name: side eye chloe
description: A little girl gives a wary sideways glance: skeptical disbelief at what someone just did.
voice: I just watched you do something ridiculous, and I genuinely cannot believe you did that right in front of me.

name: crying jordan
description: A basketball player's face crumpled in tears: crushing defeat and embarrassing failure.
voice: I lost, badly, in front of everyone, and there is no hiding how much it hurts.

name: blinking guy
description: A man blinks in disbelief: stunned, did that really just happen, double take.
voice: Wait, did that actually just happen, because I genuinely was not expecting this and I need a moment to process it.

name: mocking spongebob
description: A cartoon sponge in a chicken pose with alternating capital letters: mocking and parroting someone's words back sarcastically.
voice: I am repeating what you just said back to you in a tone that makes it sound as ridiculous as I think it is.

name: galaxy brain
description: A glowing cosmic head: an idea so overthought it becomes nonsense, pretending to be profound.
voice: I have thought about this so many times that it has curdled into something absurd, yet I am convinced it is the deepest insight I have ever had.

name: gru's plan
description: A villain presents a plan on a flipchart, and the last step reveals a flaw he did not expect: a plan backfiring.
voice: I laid out my plan feeling completely confident, only to realize partway through that I had built the very flaw I meant to avoid right into it.

name: two buttons
description: A sweating man hovers over two buttons: agonising over two incompatible choices.
voice: Two choices are in front of me, both pulling at me equally, and I am frozen, agonizing over which one I can possibly pick.

name: change my mind
description: A man sits at a table with a sign stating a hot take: confidently inviting debate over a provocative opinion.
voice: I believe this, and I am putting it out here in public, daring anyone who disagrees to actually try and prove me wrong.

name: is this a pigeon
description: A man points at a butterfly and asks if it is a pigeon: confidently misidentifying something.
voice: I am looking directly at this thing and confidently calling it something else entirely, with no idea how wrong I actually am.

name: bernie mittens
description: An old man sits cross-legged in a parka and mittens: bundled up, unbothered, patiently waiting it out.
voice: I am bundled up, settled in, and completely unbothered, perfectly content to just sit here and wait this out for as long as it takes.

name: stonks
description: A crude figure in a suit before a rising chart: celebrating a dubious financial decision as genius.
voice: I made a financial decision that was probably reckless, but I am celebrating it as though it was pure genius.

name: panik kalm panik
description: A figure panics, calms down, then panics again as news keeps shifting: rollercoaster of worry and relief.
voice: The situation keeps flipping between disastrous and fine without warning, so I keep swinging from panic to relief and straight back into panic again.

name: doge
description: A shiba inu with side-eye and words like such wow: goofy wholesome amazement.
voice: I am looking at this with wide eyed wonder, delighted and a little baffled, in a goofy, harmless kind of amazement.

name: grumpy cat
description: A cat with a permanent scowl: flatly refusing to enjoy anything.
voice: Nothing about this pleases me, and I am not going to pretend otherwise, my irritation is simply permanent.

name: salt bae
description: A chef sprinkles salt with theatrical flair: showing off, doing something with unnecessary style.
voice: I am doing something fairly ordinary, but I am making absolutely sure everyone notices how stylish and effortless I look while I do it.

name: leonardo cheers
description: A man in a tuxedo raises a champagne glass: a toast of congratulations to someone.
voice: I am raising a glass to celebrate someone else's success, genuinely happy for them in this moment.

name: pointing spiderman
description: Two identical heroes point at each other: mutual accusation, you are the same as me.
voice: I am accusing you of being exactly the same as me, and you are pointing right back, because neither of us can deny it.

name: confused travolta
description: A man looks around lost in an empty room: bewildered, looking for something that is not there.
voice: I am turning around and around in this empty space, certain that what I need should be right here, and it simply is not.

name: arthur fist
description: A cartoon aardvark's clenched fist: silent pent-up anger barely held in.
voice: I am holding back real rage right now, and it is taking everything in me not to let it explode to the surface.

name: sad keanu
description: A man sits alone on a bench eating a sandwich: lonely melancholy.
voice: I am sitting here completely alone, and the quiet around me is making me feel just how isolated I really am.

name: dancing pallbearers
description: Men dance while carrying a coffin: death or failure incoming, celebrated darkly.
voice: Something is about to end badly, and instead of dreading it, I am celebrating its downfall with dark delight.

name: elmo fire
description: A puppet raises its arms amid flames: gleeful chaos, embracing destruction.
voice: Everything around me is falling apart, and instead of panicking, I am throwing my arms up and reveling in the chaos.

name: office handshake
description: Two arms clasp hands labelled with different groups: unexpected agreement over a shared thing.
voice: We disagree about almost everything, but on this one specific thing, it turns out we are completely aligned, and that surprises us both.

name: they don't know
description: A man stands alone at a party thinking about something nobody else knows: private smug secret, feeling unnoticed.
voice: I am standing here surrounded by people, quietly satisfied because I know something none of them do.

name: uno draw 25
description: A person would rather draw 25 cards than do a simple thing: stubbornly refusing an easy request.
voice: You are asking me to do one simple thing, and I would honestly rather take on a much bigger cost than just do it.

name: bike fall
description: A cyclist jams a stick in his own wheel, falls, and blames someone else: self-sabotage followed by blame.
voice: I sabotaged this myself, and now that it has gone wrong, I am turning around and blaming you for it.

name: monkey puppet
description: A puppet monkey glances nervously sideways: awkward, caught out, pretending not to notice.
voice: I got caught doing something I should not have, and I am glancing away, pretending I did not notice a thing.

name: cat vibing
description: A cat bobs its head to music: carefree enjoyment, vibing.
voice: I am just here enjoying this moment, completely carefree, moving through it without a single worry in the world.

name: ight imma head out
description: A cartoon sponge gets up from a chair: deciding to leave an uncomfortable situation.
voice: This has gotten uncomfortable, so I am quietly getting up and leaving before it gets any worse.

name: sweating towel guy
description: A man nervously wipes sweat from his face with a towel: anxious pressure, sweating a hard decision.
voice: I am under real pressure to make this decision, and the stress of it is visibly getting to me.

name: guy tapping head
description: A man points to his head: can't have a problem if you ignore it, flawed clever reasoning.
voice: If I simply avoid dealing with this, it technically is not a problem yet, and I feel quite clever for realizing that.

name: shocked guy
description: A man gasps with an exaggerated look of shock: genuinely scandalised by what he just heard.
voice: What I just heard is genuinely appalling to me, and I cannot hide how scandalized I am by it.

name: this is where the fun begins
description: A villain grins as things get interesting: eager anticipation of a challenge.
voice: Things are about to get difficult, and instead of dreading it, I am grinning, because this is exactly the challenge I wanted.

name: pepe feels bad
description: A frog with a sad face: a quiet disappointed sadness, feels bad man.
voice: I am just quietly and deeply sad about this, no drama to it, just a heavy disappointment sitting in my chest.

name: wojak doomer
description: A tired man in a beanie smoking at night: nihilistic hopelessness and ennui.
voice: Nothing matters and nothing is going to get better, so I have stopped expecting anything and gone numb to all of it.

name: chad yes
description: A bearded man calmly says yes: confidently owning an opinion others mock.
voice: Yes, that is exactly what I believe, and it does not bother me in the least that all of you think it is ridiculous.

name: gigachad
description: A chiselled jaw in black and white: exaggerated effortless superiority.
voice: I carry myself like everything is effortless, because I am simply better at this than everyone else around me.

name: trade offer
description: A man in a suit presents a deal: I receive this, you receive that, cheeky proposal.
voice: I am proposing a deal that clearly favors me far more than you, and presenting it like it is completely fair.

name: always has been
description: An astronaut points a gun at another as they realise a truth: it was always this way, dark revelation.
voice: I just realized this troubling thing has been true all along, and now that we both know it, someone has to make sure it stays quiet.

name: anakin padme
description: A woman smiles as she asks a question, then her smile fades at the silent answer: dawning realization of a bad intention.
voice: I asked a question expecting reassurance, and the silence answering me is confirming the exact thing I was afraid to hear.

name: surprised cat
description: A cat with wide eyes and open mouth: sudden startled surprise.
voice: Something just happened so suddenly that I had no time to brace for it, and my whole body reacted before my mind caught up.

name: disappointed fan
description: A man in a stadium puts hands on hips looking let down: open disappointment.
voice: I expected so much better than this, and now I am just standing here letting my disappointment show plainly.

name: patrick wallet
description: A starfish is fooled by questions into admitting he has the wallet: obtuse logic contradiction.
voice: I answered each question honestly, one at a time, without noticing that together they were leading me straight into admitting what I meant to hide.

name: one does not simply
description: A grave warrior raises a hand: warning that a task is much harder than it sounds.
voice: I need to warn you that what you are about to attempt is far harder than it sounds, and it cannot be done carelessly.

name: i'm in danger
description: A cartoon boy smiles weakly on a bus: cheerfully realizing you are in trouble.
voice: I have just realized I am in real trouble, and somehow I am smiling weakly through it instead of panicking.

name: nobody:
description: Nobody asked, yet someone did something weird anyway: pointing out unprompted behavior.
voice: No one asked for this, but I am going to say or do it anyway, because it felt like it needed to happen regardless.

name: pikachu shocked face alternate
description: A yellow creature freezes with wide eyes: stunned speechless.
voice: I am so stunned by this that I have completely frozen, and for a moment I cannot even form a word.
